assertions.guarantee: Every final plan item has at least one ontology review item.
One plan item and rule snapshot pair has at most one review item.
Review matches use review evidence from the same plan item only.
UNVERIFIED carries no invented rule, confidence, or evidence.
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE names missing evidence or rule parameters.
Overall verdict uses conservative conflict-first aggregation.
The LLM context is an immutable snapshot of plan and review.
Every rule-bearing verdict references the latest ACTIVE authoritative rule snapshot.
Matched facts actually satisfy the structured rule trigger, including grounded baselines.
Rule time and entity grain match the reviewed plan item and evidence.
SUPPORT, CONFLICT, and NOT_APPLICABLE are determined only by review_policy after a rule trigger matches.
Public rule context is a deterministic projection of the authoritative rule card, including review_policy.
Feedback is bound to an existing review snapshot and updates runtime confidence state without mutating rule cards.
Plan ACCEPT or REJECT events bind to the exact plan source version and content hash.
